premise_adaptations: Free choice of the next frontier order is intractable for ferroplan's explicit composite-state translate (downset lattice, >= 2^36 states for the graph's 36 roots). The fixture instead visits orders in 050_frontier.rq ORDER BY ?id order over R = 1 + max id-order descents sweeps (R = 2), taking an order exactly when pending and all depends-on are alive; the planner evaluates the dependency preconditions (lifted forall/exists over depends-on facts), the generator only fixes the visit order and horizon.
A flat 169-visit root network made translate cost O(|network|^2) per state (625 states in 10 s debug); the sweep is a two-level tree (13 chunks of 13 visits) instead.
